description: This file handles dispatching messages in a Telegram bot, including message streaming, sticker processing, error handling, and topic auto-renaming within a larger chatbot framework.

classes.name: DraftLaneState
classes.description: Represents the state of a message draft lane, including streaming status and partial text.

classes.name: LaneDeliveryResult
classes.description: Represents the result of delivering a lane message, including success or failure status.

classes.name: LaneName
classes.description: Type representing the name of a message lane ('answer' or 'reasoning').

classes.name: LanePreviewLifecycle
classes.description: Type indicating the lifecycle state of a preview ('transient', 'complete').

classes.name: ArchivedPreview
classes.description: Type for storing archived preview message info.

methods.name: resolveStickerVisionSupport
methods.description: Checks if the sticker supports vision processing by loading model catalog and verifying support.

methods.name: pruneStickerMediaFromContext
methods.description: Removes sticker media from message context based on options.

methods.name: resolveTelegramReasoningLevel
methods.description: Determines the reasoning level ('off', 'on', 'stream') for a session based on config and session store.

methods.name: dispatchTelegramMessage
methods.description: Main function to handle dispatching a message in Telegram, including streaming, error handling, sticker processing, and topic renaming.
